Reranking where the provider lists the scored documents under data instead of results

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.rerank_async(LiterLlm::RerankRequest.new(documents: ['The weather is sunny today.', 'Deep learning uses neural networks.', 'Machine learning is a subset of AI.'], model: 'voyage/rerank-2', query: 'What is machine learning?'))
puts result.results.inspect
puts result.results[0].relevance_score.inspect
```
